whatTheHookContains.text: The opening frame shows a kitchen counter with a person holding a jar.
On-screen wording in the first keyframe reads READ THIS.

observations.text: The first measured short-window energy peak starts at 1.44 seconds.
Measured audio root-mean-square across the clip is 0.1372.
The opening AudioSet window carries Speech above Music.

hypotheses.text: Bringing the jar action before the first measured energy peak may change the opening's measured audio structure.
hypotheses.label: untested heuristic

experiments.edit: Re-cut so the jar action lands before the measured peak at 1.44 seconds.

phaseCommentary.text: The early phase carries the lowest predicted cortical magnitude of the clip's three phases.

tribeNotes.text: These values are predicted average-subject cortical BOLD, not audience behavior.
